name: Stromgarde Keep
summary: In the Arathi Highlands, Stromgarde Keep is divided between its royal defenders, the Syndicate and Boulderfist ogres. The fallen kingdom's battered capital holds only part of its fortress.

sections.title: Cradle of Humanity
sections.body:
Strom began as the first capital of the unified human empire of Arathor. King Thoradin founded it nearly three millennia ago. From this fortress, humanity prepared its victory over the forest trolls. Here, high elven magi taught the first hundred human spellcasters and began the long history of human wizardry.

Dalaran, Lordaeron and Stormwind rose as younger sister kingdoms while Strom's influence waned. The stubborn Trollbane dynasty remained and renamed the city Stromgarde. Through the Second War, it stood as a proud warrior bastion and an anchor of the Alliance of Lordaeron against the Orcish Horde.

sections.title: A Shattered Bastion
sections.body:
The devastation of the Third War brought mounting disasters and treachery, and Stromgarde finally broke. Its majestic stone city is now split into three warring sectors. Aristocratic Syndicate traitors hold the grand inner keep, while Boulderfist ogres have overrun the former sanctum of the mage district.

Prince Galen Trollbane and the battered Stromgarde military hold the remaining quarter. They wage a hard, bloody war on several fronts to keep their ancestral home from vanishing into memory.

faq.q: Who controls Stromgarde Keep right now?
faq.answer: Three warring forces divide the ruined city. The Syndicate holds the central inner keep, Boulderfist ogres occupy the ruined mage district, and Prince Galen Trollbane leads the surviving Stromgarde army from the remaining quarter.

faq.q: What was the Empire of Arathor?
faq.answer: The Empire of Arathor was the first unified human nation, founded nearly three thousand years ago under King Thoradin. Its capital, Strom, stood where Stromgarde Keep now stands.

faq.q: Why is the city in ruins?
faq.answer: Stromgarde's kingdom was left vulnerable and isolated in the chaos after the Third War. Betrayal within the city, attacks by the criminal Syndicate and assaults by Boulderfist ogres shattered its defenses.

Prince Galen Trollbane is the royal scion and commander of Stromgarde's surviving forces. From his embattled redoubt inside the keep, he directs the desperate defense against the Syndicate and the ogres.

angles.text: As a human, you can look to Stromgarde as the ancient heart of your race. The first human tribes united under Thoradin here, and high elves taught them the arcane arts. Seeing criminals and ogres overrun the city is a bitter sight.

As an Alliance member, you can look to Stromgarde, a founding member of the Alliance of Lordaeron during the Second War. Its beleaguered defenders remain one of the last loyal strongholds in the north, fighting to avoid total ruin.
